correctness.rationale: Legendre step coefficient identity and quadratic derivative are independently checked by exact rational polynomial identities. Signed-measure decomposition proves the unrestricted BV reduction. The explicit central root integral gives the exact sharp value; a negative logarithmic derivative of the quadratic positive-root term proves strict local dominance; 225 fully rational Bernstein quadratic L1 upper certificates rigorously cover all remaining jump locations and bound them below 9/5<K3. The actual standalone file checks/cubic_legendre_bv.py was executed successfully. Equality rigidity follows from strictness for all noncentral jumps. No infinite conclusion rests on samples.

value.rationale: This is the first ordinary Legendre truncation whose step derivative is quadratic and has two internal turning points. Its complete sharp BV norm and uniqueness of the central extremizing jump give a canonical finite-degree quantitative benchmark for Gibbs-type variation distortion; such an exact invariant is neither a trivial normalization test nor already implied by pointwise Gibbs constants. It resolves a natural complete optimization over all BV inputs without claiming a higher-degree general theorem.
